# Visual Novel with a Turn Based Combat System RPG

**Genre:** Fantasy, Action, Comedy

My idea is to create a sort of a game that feels like a “joke”/meme to make other classmates laugh, but essentially give it great quality in terms of design and promote internet culture and ACG. I think this balance can help us give the game a lot of personality while remaining quite competitive.

The teacher said himself he won’t compile the game, so there is almost no point in making a significantly long game.  
---

## Combat System Characteristics:

- Abilities will require user input to be more effective  
  - Adds game difficulty and interactivity  
- User Input against enemy attacks (parry)


  
A character’s kit could be as simple as:

- **Skill:** Requires user input and ability becomes more effective with correct input.  
- **Ultimate:** Can be casted after casting a certain number of skills

It should be simple enough so that we can “mass produce” characters, my idea is to make the character creation process simple enough so that everyone can create their own characters or port celebrities or characters from games/shows into the game and create a sort of multiverse (fortnite (sorry)), just a thing so everyone has their satisfaction.

Although Miku should be the main character in the story, gameplay-wise, she can be optional and other characters can be played instead. But for example, Miku’s kit could be:

**Skill:** Rythm tiles are randomly generated on the screen and the user must press them correctly (rythm game). Miku will then deal increased damage based on the accuracy of the rythm.

**Ultimate:** This but with Miku on a Diandong instead:  
![][image1]

With simple enough kits, we can have a variety of characters to showcase and everyone can create their own characters based on their own hobbies/interests. For Anmol since he likes platformers, one character could have a short platform in their ability and successfully completing the short platformer could increase damage dealt.

For classes, we use the classic ones Fighter (DPS), Wizard (Buff???), Cleric (Sustain), and Rogue (???)

For the turn order, either we can have a SPD based one(10000/character’s speed) and use an action value system, or classic turn by turn.

## My Lore Idea:

**Initial Situation:** Miku is a worldwide popular idol, everybody loves her\! As she is getting ready to head on stage for the concert of her world tour, she wakes up… she was just dreaming. Despite her aspirations, she is actually just a student at BIT and she is about to be late to her C Programming class. She leaves the dorm, and takes a diandong with her best friend, Cupcakke, on her way to class. *(if anmol insists for a platformer, we can have a faux-platformer for our exploration instead of a pokemon like)*.

**Trigger:** A mysterious individual shows up on their way but quickly flees the scene. Miku and her best friend try to follow, until they realise they’ve been lured. The individual uses magic to transport them into another dimension (which is just the same BIT campus but cyberpunk, we can try to use AI to make the backgrounds). The individual introduces themselves, they are a host of an idol competition and this underworld cyberpunk BIT is where students login to watch some performances.

 Miku, who always dreamed of being a world-wide star immediately agrees, Cupcakke feels sketchy about this.

(this is just for the lore as we will just use the combat system) Each participant has an associated rank, starting from 5\. The rank increases/decreases upon duelling fellow participants. A participant can only challenge participants with a higher rank, and the participant with the higher rank cannot refuse the duel request. When dueling a fellow student who participates in the idol competition, they will both use their voices to sing a song. When a duel is initiated, the battle goes live and students can gather around. The winner of the duel is decided by whichever person gets the most likes/TikTok gifts. After defeating an opponent, the winner will increase in rank while the loser decreases. Upon getting a negative rank, the contestant is disqualified. In order to win the competition, a participant must reach 30\.

**Adventures:** Find random anime/game/show characters or celebrities to fight against in the overworld, successfully defeating them will acquire them in the inventory and can become playable. Continue until rank requirements (we can reduce)

**Plot Twist:** Despite doing as the individual instructed and making it to be the last idol remaining in the competition, the host does admit that it is thanks to Miku’s incredible singing that she has gained the hearts of all student audiences and made it this far, thus making her the best singer. However, the host reveals themselves as the antagonist, as this idol competition was actually nothing but an AI-training camp. As Miku was the “winner” her voice would be used to create AI-generated songs while being completely uncredited, a profit making machine. As Miku realises she has been deceived, she feels heart-broken. Her dream of becoming a worldwide idol shattered, and her voice was about to become a product. But she cannot accept this fate\! She will fight for the justice of her own dreams but also her own voice.

**Resolution:** Miku embarks on an ultimate boss battle against the host. After she thought she successfully defeated the boss, she realises that her software was hacked (well, she was never human to begin with) and that she is slowly getting more and more corrupted. Her emotions start to fade away as she suffers from ChatGPT Syndrome, thus fulfilling the initial goal of the antagonist, to turn Miku into an AI song generator. The last human part of Miku then asks Cupcakke to fight her to prevent the upcoming tragedy, thus engaging in another boss battle, this time against Miku, who sacrificed herself.

**Final Situation:** As Cupcakke deals the final blow on Miku, the disappearance of hatsune miku is imminent, shedding one last tear and a last goodbye to her friend. Cyberpunk BIT then shutdowns, Cupcakke returns to the real world and then mourns her best friend by making her picture the logo of BITShare.
